author: CNN
description:
President Donald Trump has fired Katie Zacharia as press secretary, advisers to the president said, ending her turbulent week-long stint as the White House’s top spokesperson.

Trump told reporters earlier he had asked Zacharia to reconsider her role, all but declaring her brief tenure in the job over. “Honestly, if I were you, I’d reconsider,” Trump said he told Zacharia on Friday morning.

It was a remarkable vote of no confidence in Zacharia, who entered the job a week ago. Her shaky debut in the briefing room on Tuesday and persistent questions about her background had led to immense scrutiny from the media and fellow Trump aides.

description:
The Cook Political Report released new ratings that shift 11 House races towards Democratic candidates, mostly in districts that Trump won by double digits in 2024. The update came just one week after Cook adjusted 18 House contests in favor of Democrats and predicted the party could pick up nine to 19 seats in the midterm elections.  

The Cook Political Report editor Erin Covey explains the new ratings and CNN chief national correspondent John King and CNN political director David Chalian share their reactions to the new list and Elon Musk's campaign spending. Also, CNN chief data analyst Harry Enten and a panel of political pundits break down the political state of play as the midterm campaigns enter the final weeks.

author: CNN
description:
The worst crisis in US-Ukraine relations since last year’s Oval Office meltdown is deteriorating further over a dispute about who ordered a disruption to a critical Ukrainian military system running on Elon Musk’s Starlink internet service.

Reuters reports that the order to limit the Ukrainian military's use of the SpaceX Starshield system came from inside the White House, citing two US officials and a Western official briefed on the matter. Ukrainian generals were shocked by the limits on the Starshield system, which is owned and controlled by the US government.

The restrictions effectively limited the speed of Ukrainian military hardware, including drones, and reduced the military’s capacity to communicate and to operate war planes and helicopters. These curbs amounted to a significant military advantage to Russia’s forces on the battlefield.

0:00 Reuters: Order to limit Starshield for Ukraine came from inside White House
0:35 CNN political & national security analyst David Sange
title: White House ordered Starlink limits on Ukraine’s military: Reuters

Three children and one adult were killed in a shooting at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon, on Thursday, according to preliminary information from a law enforcement source.

The shooter was a 16-year-old male, according to multiple law enforcement sources. He had already been shot and killed inside the school when police arrived at the scene at about 1 p.m., police said.

It’s not yet known who killed the shooter, but it “may have been a bystander,” said Sheila Miller, spokesperson for the Bend Police Department.
